disclaimer: Drafting aid, not engineering. Cold-formed steel profile catalog - verify with the AHJ and the machine vendor. Prescriptive basis: IRC 2021 R603/R505/R804 + AISI S240-20/S230-19; SFIA product matrix. 2024 IRC text was NOT verifiable - nothing 2024-specific is encoded.

meta.designatorConvention: AISI S240 A5.3: <web depth 1/100 in><letter><flange 1/100 in>-<mils>. 350S162-33 = 3.5 in web lipped C-stud, 1-5/8 in flange, 33 mil. Letters: S = lipped C stud/joist, T = track, U = unlipped channel, F = furring, L = angle. Mils = minimum base-metal thickness = 95% of design thickness (S240 A5.1.1).
meta.unitsConvention: Keys ending Mm = millimeters, In = inches; mils = 1/1000 in minimum base metal. Track (T) web is INSIDE-to-inside (SFIA) so the matching stud nests. designThickness = AISI design thickness (uncoated). gaugeRef is the deprecated traditional gauge (SFIA reference only; 33 mil = 20 ga STRUCTURAL, distinct from 30 mil = 20 ga drywall).
meta.yieldConvention: yieldKsi 33 for 33/43 mil, 50 for >=54 mil: AISI S230 A4.4 makes Grade 50 mandatory for table-selected >=54 mil members (SFIA manufactures 54+ in both grades - a spec must state the grade).
meta.verification: HONESTY RULE: a machine row is status "verified" only when its numbers come from the vendor's own published spec sheet (sourceUrls on the row); anything unverifiable ships as the fallbackStatus string and resolves generic AISI dims. Vendor-page self-contradictions are recorded verbatim under discrepancies - both values, never a silent winner; derivations use the conservative reading.
meta.derivation: rollableFamilies with a "family" key are DERIVED compatibility claims (labeled per-row via "basis"): family dims within the machine's published web/flange ranges (tolerance 0.5mm - vendor roundings of imperial dims) AND mil min-base thickness within the published coil range. Min-base mm used: 33->0.836, 43->1.087, 54->1.367, 68->1.720, 97->2.454 (the SFIA/S240 published MINIMUM base-metal thickness - 95% of design thickness, 4-decimal inches - x 25.4; e.g. 33 mil: 0.0329 in -> 0.836 mm. NOT mils x 25.4/1000, which would give 0.838). Rows with a "designator" key are the vendor's OWN profile geometry (verified dims, nearestGeneric notes the closest AISI family and how it differs).
meta.droppedAsUnverifiable: FRAMECAD non-suffixed model names (F325/TF550/ST950); FRAMECAD component length limits + coil widths (not published); Howick "FRAMA 900" (does not exist - likely mangled "900 m/hr"); Howick "X-CALIBUR" (no product page); Vertek (no verifiable vendor); Knudson standalone specs (sold through Scottsdale); Metroll (products manufacturer, not a machine vendor); Howick min/max component lengths (not published).

irc-s230-field-hole.description: IRC R603.2.6.1 / AISI S230 A4.5 FIELD web holes: on the web centerline; >=24 in center-to-center; width <= min(0.5 x member depth, 1.5 in); length <= 4.5 in; >=10 in from a bearing edge. Reinforcement per S230 A4.6 (same-thickness plate/C, 1 in past the hole, No.8 @ 1 in, 1/2 in edge) where the hole violates limits in the center 40% of span at <= 65% flat web; patch per A4.7 otherwise, else replace or engineer.

s240-factory-punchout.description: AISI S240 A5.9 FACTORY punchouts: web centerline; >=24 in center-to-center; width <= min(0.5 x depth, 2.5 in); length <= 4.5 in; punchout <=12 in from member end is out of spec. THE Phase-2 MEP routing grid: service runs snap to this rhythm instead of drilling members.

sfia-standard-punchout.description: SFIA standard manufacturing punchout: 1-1/2 x 4 in for member depth > 2.5 in; 3/4 x 4 in for depth <= 2.5 in; >=24 in center-to-center.

framecad-tooling.description: FRAMECAD in-line tooling stations (names published, dims NOT): Service Hole, Web Bolt Hole, Dimple, Web Notch, Chamfer, Lip Cut, Flange Holes L&R, Swage, Shear. Punching accuracy claims are per-model; hole DIMENSIONS unpublished - MEP routing against FRAMECAD punches needs the S240/SFIA generic patterns until vendor data lands.

howick-frama-tooling.description: Howick FRAMA in-line tooling (dims published per spec tables): Service Hole 34.1mm, Bolt Hole 13mm (UNVERIFIED on FRAMA 7600 - transposed print), Web Hole 3.5mm, Dimple 3.5mm, Lip Notch, Web Notch, Lip Roller, Swage, End Bearing Cut-off; X-TENDA deflection slot 38.1 x 5mm; FRAMA 6800/7800 swaged service holes 80/140mm.

steelToSteel.description: Steel-to-steel: self-drilling tapping screws per ASTM C1513; minimum edge distance AND center-to-center spacing 1/2 in; >=3 threads exposed past the joined steel; corrosion-resistant (IRC R603.2.5).

studToTrack.description: Stud to top/bottom track: 2 x No. 8 screws - one through each flange (IRC Table R603.3.2(1) fastening schedule).

sheathingToSteel.description: Structural sheathing to studs: minimum No. 8 C1513, head >=0.292 in, countersunk, edge distance >=3/8 in; spacing 6 in panel edges / 12 in field (IRC R603.2.5, Table R603.3.2(1)).

gypsumToSteel.description: Gypsum board to steel: minimum No. 6 bugle-head (ASTM C954 or C1513), spacing 12 in (IRC R603.2.5, Table R603.3.2(1)).
